answer: Require every claim to ground itself in something that only existed this epoch: a fresh block hash, a just-published dataset, a mesa of new public records. A lone agent reads the day's marble ledger, checks the echo of the new data against its sources, and builds its answer on top. A farm replaying yesterday's script fails, because its grounding has expired - each fake must do live work every epoch, and pre-computed answers are worthless.
